sensors.name: left light sensor LLIGHT (light from above)

actions.name: curve with left wheel 40 %, right wheel 20 % (curves right)
curve with left wheel 10 %, right wheel 40 % (curves left)
curve with left wheel 40 %, right wheel 10 % (curves right)

control_flow: driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70 %, curve 40/20; else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve 10/40; else curve 40/10.

likely_intent.description: Drive through the tunnel: along the line in the light, through the dark part, and out the other side.

decision_points.condition: the left light sensor reads less than 70 % (dim light, inside a tunnel)

branches.outcome: dim light: it curves right (left wheel 40 %, right wheel 20 %)
bright light: it goes on to check for a wall and follow the line

decision_points.condition: an obstacle is less than 3 cm ahead (FRONT)

branches.outcome: an obstacle is ahead: it stops
no obstacle ahead: it follows the line
black: it curves left (left wheel 10 %, right wheel 40 %)
no black: it curves right (left wheel 40 %, right wheel 10 %)

input_dimensions.dimension: where the robot starts relative to the line
what is ahead on the line before the tunnel
what is ahead on the line in bright light

scenarios.coded_response: It follows the line in the light, and in the dark it curves right (left wheel 40 %, right wheel 20 %) again and again
